name: Yumemi ga Cheek!
source:
The protagonist, Mikami Hiroki, is a diligent member of the discipline committee. He sternly confiscates the goods of his classmates who borrow and lend pornographic books, and coolly ignores his best friend's dirty jokes... but in reality, he is a healthy teenager who spends his days agonizing over his desire to do naughty things.

"It's not that I'm particularly erotic! It's just that there are too many temptations."

Toriumi Hinata, my childhood friend, is a silly girl with big breasts whose breasts seem to be the only source of nutrients. My classmate, Kogure Miori, is the cutest in the class and always glances my way.  My cool junior, Seto Suzu, is also a member of the discipline committee and adores me.  And my older sister, Mikami Juri, is an honor student with a bro complex.

One day, an incident leads to the start of naughty days with these girls...!?
translation:
主人公三上弘树是一位勤奋的风纪委员。他严厉地没收了借阅色情书籍的同学的物品，对最好的朋友的黄色笑话漠不关心……但实际上，他是一个健康的青少年，每天都在为自己做坏事的欲望而苦恼。

“不是我特别好色！只是诱惑太多了。”

我青梅竹马的鸟海日向是个傻乎乎的巨乳女孩，乳房似乎是唯一的营养来源。我的同学小暮美织是班里最可爱的，总是朝我这边看。我的帅气后辈濑户铃也是风纪委员，很喜欢我。我的姐姐三上树里是一名有着兄弟情结的优等生。

某天，一件事情让女孩们开始了淘气的日子……！？
